readme:
IEANTN RH one-prime and network evolution: source/evidence export

Start: Solutions/RHOnePrimeEvolution.v1/README.md and REPRODUCE.md.
The five offline HTML reports are in that study's reports/ directory.
The 30-row mathematical theorem matrix and RELEASE_RESULTS.json state scope and limits.

Mathematical source commit:109729571ac5e6ea38944c965abad11a8dad4d43.
Published owner branch:research/rh-one-prime-network-20261124 at
https://github.com/hs-chae/IEANTN_test
This export adds final publication/review files to the pinned mathematical source.

The two self-contained application proof packets contain300 and53 Lean sources.
Use the pinned Lean/Mathlib environment and prepare_proof_context.py, then run
scripts/reproduce_packets.py as explained in REPRODUCE.md. Both complete packets
were actually compiled after relocation; no predecessor application objects used.
The export is not a clone of the entire inherited network: use the owner branch
for ordinary canonical network/core builds. Dependencies are pinned, not bundled.

Kernel numerical verification is not source-first C/C++/CUDA PV. RH and the named
analytic source predicates remain explicit. The asymptotic0.834021 coefficient
has no explicit onset; the explicit0.8768 theorem uses a different analytic input
and a literature-backed finite gap bridge. No global optimality/record claim.
Official Comparator approval absent;49 inherited receipt-identity errors unchanged.

Every included file is listed with byte count and SHA-256 in BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json.
Verify/extract with scripts/build_evidence_bundle.py verify --archive ZIP --extract FRESH.
Rebuild the exact ZIP using its build subcommand with this manifest as selection
and this extracted directory as repository. Commands are detailed in REPRODUCE.md.
Original research/locked inputs and accepted proof banks remain; only documented
regenerable owned scratch copies were deleted. Source-fetch recipes and the
public-domain Nicely fallback are included; other complete papers are not republished.
